title: Alwassa–Gwandu campaign
text: The Alwassa–Gwandu campaign was a two-part military confrontation in November 1805 during the Jihad of Usman dan Fodio in present-day northwestern Nigeria. It was fought between the Sokoto jihadists, led by Abdullahi dan Fodio, Ali Jedo, and Muhammad Bello, and a broad coalition of Gobir, Kebbi, Zamfara, and allied Tuareg groups under Yunfa, Muhammadu Hodi, and the Tuareg chief Agunbulu.
